description: This PHP source file defines the ColumnAndRowAttributes class responsible for parsing and applying attributes to columns and rows in an XLSX worksheet during the reading process. The class reads XML data structures related to worksheet layout, extracts attributes such as width, outline level, visibility, and styling, and applies these attributes to the worksheet object within PhpSpreadsheet.

classes.name: ColumnAndRowAttributes
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing and applying column and row attributes from worksheet XML data in XLSX files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the worksheet object and optional worksheet XML data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and applies column and row attributes from worksheet XML, with optional read filtering.

methods.name: setColumnAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes for a specific column based on provided attribute data.

methods.name: setRowAttributes
methods.description: Sets attributes for a specific row based on provided attribute data.

methods.name: isFilteredColumn
methods.description: Determines if a column is filtered out based on the read filter.

methods.name: readColumnAttributes
methods.description: Parses column attribute XML nodes into an array of attributes.

methods.name: readColumnRangeAttributes
methods.description: Extracts attributes from a column XML node.

methods.name: isFilteredRow
methods.description: Checks if a row should be filtered out based on the read filter.

methods.name: readRowAttributes
methods.description: Parses row attribute XML nodes into an array of attributes.
